title: Julie's Chicken
directions: Wipe off chicken pieces. Mix flour, salt, paprika & pepper. Coat chicken c seasoned flour -
Preheat oven to 350°. Heat a wide skillet c a little oil for frying. Brown chicken both sides. Combine sauce ingred.
When chicken is golden, arrange in a 9x13 pan. Pour sauce over top. Bake uncovered, for 40 min. until chicken is cooked.
Add green pepper & cook for another 5-10 min.

title: Turkey Stir-Fry Supreme
ingredients: 500 g (1 lb) boneless fresh Alberta turkey breast*
750 mL (3 cups) thinly sliced vegetables (carrots, celery, broccoli, snowpeas, red or green pepper)
directions: Cut turkey into narrow strips or bite-size pieces.
In a wok or large fry pan, stir-fry turkey in 15 ml (1 tbsp) oil until no longer pink. Remove turkey from pan.
Add remaining oil, vegetables, mushrooms, onion and garlic and stir-fry until vegetables are tender crisp (3 to 4 minutes).
Add soy sauce and oyster sauce (optional).
Combine chicken broth and cornstarch mixture.
Add turkey and cornstarch mixture.
Stir and cook until heated through and sauce thickens.
Serve over steamed rice or noodles if desired.
notes: Use your imagination to vary ingredients and use what you have on hand.
*Ground turkey may be substituted for boneless turkey breast. Cook over medium heat stirring and separating turkey as it cooks.
Nutritional Analysis Per Serving: 202 Cal., 24.72 g Protein, 7.27 g Fat, 9.55 g Carbohydrates.
TIP: Turkey breast is very lean and will dry out if overcooked. Use moderate heat and cook only until the pink turns white.

• Add remaining oil, vegetables, mushrooms, onion and garlic and stir-fry until vegetables are tender crisp (3 to 4 minutes).

title: Lemon chicken with pasta — most-requested recipe
ingredients: 500 g boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips
directions: Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large frypan. Saute chicken strips over high heat until cooked. Remove from pan and set aside. Add 1 tablespoon more oil to pan and saute broccoli until tender crisp. Remove from pan; set aside.

Add remaining tablespoon oil to pan and saute onion, garlic, rosemary and oregano until tender. Blend in flour, gradually stir in milk. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture boils and thickens. Stir in Parmesan cheese, lemon rind and juice. Return chicken and broccoli to pan. Add salt and pepper to taste. Reheat to serving temperature. Serve over hot cooked pasta and sprinkle with chopped tomato.
notes: Newspaper clipping (Calgary Herald column, Cynny Willet); right edge cut off

Lemon chicken
with pasta —
most-requested
recipe.
4 tablespoons vegetable oil, divided
500 g boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips
2 cups thinly-sliced broccoli
3/4 cup sliced green onions
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 1/4 teaspoons dried rosemary leaves, crushed
1 teaspoon dried oregano
1/4 cup all-purpose flour
2 cups milk
1/4 cup grated Parmesan
1 teaspoon grated lemon rind
1/4 cup lemon juice
salt and pepper
3/4 pound cooked and drained spaghetti
chopped fresh tomato
Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large frypan. Saute chicken strips over high heat until cooked. Remove from pan and set aside. Add 1 tablespoon more oil to pan and saute broccoli until tender crisp. Remove from pan; set aside.
Add remaining tablespoon oil to pan and saute onion, garlic, rosemary and oregano until tender. Blend in flour, gradually stir in milk. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture boils and thickens. Stir in Parmesan cheese, lemon rind and juice. Return chicken and broccoli to pan. Add salt and pepper to taste. Reheat to serving temperature. Serve over hot cooked pasta and sprinkle with chopped tomato.
